name: vault-memory
description: Turns an Obsidian vault into memory any coding agent can query: local recall before searching elsewhere, a frontmatter contract, freshness (replaced, expired, contradictions), duplicate-safe note writing, pattern synthesis and a self-contained panel. Deterministic: no network, no model, no tokens. Replies in the user language.

interface.shortDescription: Query and write your Obsidian vault as agent memory
defaultPrompt: Did this happen before? Search my vault.
Save what we just learned to the vault.
